column1: # One line per pinned issuance: nominal archive timestamp (yyyymmddHHMM
# sha256 of its Forecast Discussion and 3-Day Forecast report. Only complete pairs are
# pinned: NOAA never published the 3-day forecast for 202408071230 and 202502111230
# the archive itself has two long gaps (2024-05-15 to 2024-06-16
# Pinning makes a build reproducible even when NOAA publishes a correction afterwards
# makes the expected archive contents explicit instead of whatever a 404 sweep happens to find.
